build_demux_config: build a demux config to load headerless raw PCM audio files with a specified format
create_decode_config: create a decode config to specify a custom decoder like libopenh264 for H264 video
build_cuda_config: build a CUDA config to set the device index and custom stream for GPU data transfer
create_video_encode_config: create a video encode config to set frame rate, pixel format, and bit rate for encoding
build_cpu_storage: build a CPU storage block with pinned memory for faster GPU data transfer
